components.name: Button
components.description: Default bordered button for nearly every action.
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid var(--line, #d9dde3); background: var(--surface, #fff); color: var(--fg, #161b22); padding: 6px 12px; font: 500 13px/1.4 'Archivo Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-btn:hover { background: var(--sunken, #eef0f3); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #0f6e8c); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn:disabled { opacity: .5; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one main action in an area.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid var(--accent, #0f6e8c); background: var(--accent, #0f6e8c); color: var(--surface, #fff); padding: 6px 12px; font: 500 13px/1.4 'Archivo Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--accent, #0f6e8c) 90%, transparent); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #0f6e8c); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Danger Button
components.description: Destructive action; confirms in a dialog.
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid var(--bad, #b03a2e); background: var(--surface, #fff); color: var(--bad, #b03a2e); padding: 6px 12px; font: 500 13px/1.4 'Archivo Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-btn-danger:hover { background: var(--bad-soft, #f7e0dc); } .ds-btn-danger:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #0f6e8c); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Input
components.description: Sunken mono field for values, search and selects.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid var(--line, #d9dde3); background: var(--sunken, #eef0f3); color: var(--fg, #161b22); padding: 6px 10px; font: 400 13px/1.4 'Azeret Mono Variable', ui-monospace, monospace; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: color-mix(in oklab, var(--muted, #5d6773) 70%, transparent); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #0f6e8c); }

components.name: Status Pill

components.html: Running 3/3 Needs approval Failed
components.css: .ds-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 2px 8px; font: 500 12px/16px 'Archivo Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 9999px; background: currentColor; } .ds-pill-ok { background: var(--ok-soft, #dff1e7); color: var(--ok, #1f7a4d); } .ds-pill-warn { background: var(--warn-soft, #f8ecd2); color: var(--warn, #8f5c06); } .ds-pill-bad { background: var(--bad-soft, #f7e0dc); color: var(--bad, #b03a2e); }

components.name: Card
components.description: Flat bordered container for setup sections and progress.
components.css: .ds-card { border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid var(--line, #d9dde3); background: var(--surface, #fff); padding: 16px; font: 400 14px/1.5 'Archivo Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--fg, #161b22); } .ds-card-title { margin: 0; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-card-body { margin: 12px 0 0; color: var(--muted, #5d6773); } .ds-card-body code { font: 13px 'Azeret Mono Variable', ui-monospace, monospace; color: var(--fg, #161b22); }

components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; padding: 8px 16px; background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--surface, #fff) 95%, transparent); backdrop-filter: blur(8px); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line, #d9dde3); font-family: 'Archivo Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-brand { margin-right: 12px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.025em; color: var(--fg, #161b22); text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav-item { border-radius: 6px; padding: 4px 10px; font-size: 13px; color: var(--muted, #5d6773); text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav-item:hover { color: var(--fg, #161b22); } .ds-nav-item[aria-current=page] { background: var(--accent-soft, #dcedf2); color: var(--accent, #0f6e8c); font-weight: 600; } .ds-count { margin-left: 4px; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 0 6px; font-size: 11px; background: var(--warn-soft, #f8ecd2); color: var(--warn, #8f5c06); } .ds-nav-settings { border-left: 1px solid var(--line, #d9dde3); padding-left: 12px; font-size: 13px; color: var(--muted, #5d6773); text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav-settings:hover { color: var(--fg, #161b22); }

components.css: .ds-table-box { overflow-x: auto; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid var(--line, #d9dde3); background: var(--surface, #fff); } .ds-table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; text-align: left; font: 400 14px/1.4 'Archivo Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: var(--fg, #161b22); } .ds-table th { background: var(--sunken, #eef0f3); padding: 8px 12px; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.05em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--muted, #5d6773); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line, #d9dde3); } .ds-table td { padding: 10px 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line, #d9dde3); } .ds-stack { font-weight: 500; } .ds-svc { background: var(--sunken, #eef0f3); font-size: 13px; } .ds-svc td { padding-top: 6px; padding-bottom: 6px; } .ds-num { text-align: right; } .ds-table .ds-pill { display: inline-flex; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 2px 8px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; background: var(--ok-soft, #dff1e7); color: var(--ok, #1f7a4d); } .ds-btn-sm { border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid var(--line, #d9dde3); background: var(--surface, #fff); padding: 2px 8px; font: 500 12px 'Archivo Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--fg, #161b22); cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-sm:hover { background: var(--sunken, #eef0f3); }

components.css: .ds-menu { min-width: 15rem; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid var(--line, #d9dde3); background: var(--surface, #fff); padding: 4px; font: 400 13px/1.4 'Archivo Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--fg, #161b22); box-shadow: 0 10px 15px -3px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1), 0 4px 6px -4px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1); } .ds-mi { border-radius: 4px; padding: 6px 10px; cursor: default; } .ds-mi:hover { background: var(--sunken, #eef0f3); } .ds-mi-toggle { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; } .ds-tog { position: relative; width: 28px; height: 16px; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--line, #d9dde3); flex-shrink: 0; transition: background-color 150ms; } .ds-tog.on { background: var(--accent, #0f6e8c); } .ds-tog span { position: absolute; top: 2px; left: 2px; width: 12px; height: 12px; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--surface, #fff); transition: left 150ms; } .ds-tog.on span { left: 14px; } .ds-sep { margin: 4px 0; border: 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--line, #d9dde3); } .ds-mi-danger { color: var(--bad, #b03a2e); } .ds-mi-danger:hover { background: var(--bad-soft, #f7e0dc); }

components.css: .ds-cap { font: 400 14px/1.5 'Archivo Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--fg, #161b22); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-cap p { margin: 0; } .ds-cap-fig { font: 400 1.125rem 'Azeret Mono Variable', ui-monospace, monospace; } .ds-muted { color: var(--muted, #5d6773); } .ds-bar { display: flex; height: 8px; margin-top: 8px; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--sunken, #eef0f3); } .ds-bar span { height: 100%; } .ds-bar span + span { border-left: 1px solid var(--surface, #fff); } .ds-legend { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 4px 16px; margin-top: 8px; font-size: 12px; color: var(--muted, #5d6773); } .ds-legend span { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; } .ds-legend i { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 2px; } .ds-legend code { font-family: 'Azeret Mono Variable', ui-monospace, monospace; }

components.name: Run Strip
components.description: A backup's last 14 days, one mark per day: fill height says how the run went (full, two thirds, a quarter, a hairline), the tint repeats it. A day with a run is a link; the day on show keeps an accent outline.
components.css: .ds-strip { display: flex; align-items: flex-end; gap: 4px; margin: 0; padding: 4px; list-style: none; } .ds-strip li { display: flex; } .ds-day { display: flex; align-items: flex-end; width: 16px; height: 36px; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 4px; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-day span { width: 100%; } a.ds-day:hover { outline: 2px solid var(--line, #d9dde3); } a.ds-day:focus-visible, a.ds-day[aria-current=true] { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #0f6e8c); } .ds-ok { background: var(--ok-soft, #dff1e7); } .ds-ok span { height: 100%; background: var(--ok, #1f7a4d); } .ds-warn { background: var(--warn-soft, #f8ecd2); } .ds-warn span { height: 66.667%; background: var(--warn, #8f5c06); } .ds-bad { background: var(--bad-soft, #f7e0dc); } .ds-bad span { height: 25%; background: var(--bad, #b03a2e); } .ds-run { background: var(--accent-soft, #dcedf2); } .ds-run span { height: 100%; background: var(--accent, #0f6e8c); } .ds-none { background: var(--sunken, #eef0f3); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--line, #d9dde3); } .ds-none span { height: 1px; background: var(--line, #d9dde3); } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) { .ds-run span { animation: ds-pulse 2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.6, 1) infinite; } } @keyframes ds-pulse { 50% { opacity: 0.5; } }

components.css: .ds-prog { min-width: 10rem; font: 400 12px/1rem 'Archivo Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--muted, #5d6773); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-prog p { margin: 4px 0 0; } .ds-prog-bar { height: 6px; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--sunken, #eef0f3); } .ds-prog-bar span { display: block; height: 100%; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--accent, #0f6e8c); transition: width 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); }

narrative.overview:
A dense, calm operations console for one server. The first thing on any screen is state: a table of what runs, tinted pills for how it is doing, a strip or banner for what is waiting. Controls sit at the end of the row or in the page header, one step behind the state they act on. Everything is flat, bordered and evenly lit; color appears only when it carries meaning (status, the accent action, the core host).

Visible copy is short and plain. Explanations live behind a small question-mark help popover, and anything long or focused (logs, history, a grant review) opens in a large dialog over the page instead of growing the page. Light and dark are the same system: every token is redefined under `.dark`, chosen by the operator (system, light, dark) in Settings.
keyCharacteristics: Compact base type (14px) with a 13px control size and mono for every machine value.
Status through tinted pills (soft background, strong text, a current-color dot), never through saturated fills.
Flat surfaces separated by 1px lines; shadows only on things that float.
Tables are the primary layout; detail columns drop out below md so a phone never scrolls sideways.
A purple `core` hue reserved for the core host.

rules.name: The Tint Pair Rule
rules.body: Every status hue is used as strong text on its own soft tint (pills, alerts, notices). Never a saturated status fill with white text. A data mark follows the same pairing without text: a run strip's day is a strong fill standing in a column of its own soft tint.

rules.name: The Core Is Purple Rule
rules.body: The core hue appears only on core-host surfaces; a stack control is never purple, and the core host is never teal.

rules.name: The Quiet When Fine Rule
rules.body: Healthy state reads as muted text ("Up to date", "Healthy") or a green pill; amber and red appear only when something needs the operator.

rules.name: The Machine Speaks Mono Rule
rules.body: If the daemon produced it (rev, path, name, value, log line), it is set in Azeret Mono; human sentences never are.

rules.name: The Label Is A Column Rule
rules.body: The uppercase label style names a column or a field kind. It never sits above a heading as an eyebrow.

rules.name: The Only Floaters Cast Shadows Rule
rules.body: Cards, tables, banners and buttons have no shadow. If it isn't portaled above the page, it doesn't get one.

rules.name: The Shape Carries State Rule
rules.body: A mark that shows state without words says it in shape as well as hue. A day in the run strip is a column whose fill height tells how the run went (full, two thirds, a quarter, a hairline), so it still reads in greyscale and for a colour-blind reader; the tint only repeats it. Every such mark also has a spoken name.

dos: Do put state before controls: the table or pill first, the action at the row's end or in the page header.
Do use the soft-tint pill or alert for any status, picking the tone by meaning (ok, warn, bad, info, idle).
Do set every machine value in Azeret Mono and give numeric columns tabular figures.
Do open long or focused content (logs, history, review) in a wide Modal rather than lengthening the page.
Do put the explanation in a HelpTip next to a short visible sentence.
Do hide detail columns below md (`max-md:hidden`) and keep the table's min-width to md and up; move a column a phone still needs under the primary cell instead of hiding it.
Do keep one primary button per area; everything else is the default bordered button.
Do put a surface's rare or destructive controls in a header dropdown menu, the destructive item last behind a separator.
Do give a mark that shows state a shape for each state as well as a tint, and a spoken name that says the state in words.
Do show live progress where the state already sits (the row's last-run cell, the run on show), not in a separate panel.
Do keep a form to what most people set, with the rest in an Advanced fold.
Do write the reason a form cannot be saved as a sentence under the form; the disabled button's title is only a second copy.
donts: Don't use the core purple on anything that is not the core host, or teal on the core host.
Don't add shadows to cards, tables or banners; only portaled popovers and dialogs float.
Don't use the uppercase label style as an eyebrow or kicker above a heading.
Don't fill a surface with a saturated status color; status is strong text on its soft tint. (A run strip's marks are data marks, not surfaces.)
Don't let a page scroll sideways on a phone; the scroll belongs inside the table box.
Don't tell two states of a mark apart by colour alone.
Don't lock a dialog unless it has to end through its own action; every other dialog keeps Close first, Escape and the click outside.
